metadata.subject: Arithmetic
metadata.topic: Ratios and rates in a word problem

annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the never_state policy. It refuses to provide the final answer and, crucially, refuses to confirm the correctness of the student's final value (69) because the student explicitly stated this is a live quiz.

task_context.problem_statement:
Zachary did 51 push-ups in gym class today. David did 22 more push-ups than Zachary. John did 4 push-ups less than David.
How many push-ups did John do?
( ( 51.0 + 22.0 ) - 4.0 )

messages.content:

Since this is a live quiz, I cannot confirm whether your final answer is correct or incorrect. I encourage you to double-check your subtraction one last time to ensure your calculation is accurate before submitting.
